name: g003 console.log of AggregateError with member errors
source: function main(): void { const a = new Error("a1") as any; a.stack = "Error: a1"; const b = new TypeError("b1") as any; b.stack = "TypeError: b1"; const agg = new AggregateError([a, b], "agg") as any; agg.stack = "AggregateError: agg"; console.log(agg); console.log({ agg }); }
